test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that corrects the incorrectly spelt words in the given sentence.

Fifty people have been taken into polise custoudy.

options.text: Fivety people have been taken into polise custody.
Fiffty people have been taken into polis custoudy
Fifity people have been taken into police custoudy.
Fifty people have been taken into police custody.

solution:
The correct answer is *'**Fifty people have been taken into police custody.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We have to choose the** appropriate sentence** from the given options, which is free from any **spelling mistakes.**
 
• In the given sentence, the spelling of '**polise**' is erroneous. Its correct spelling is** 'police'.**
 
• Of the given options**, only option 4 **is having **no spelling error.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**
